user.title: Teslemetry access token
user.description: Create an access token in the Teslemetry console (teslemetry.com/console). Alerts are streamed for every vehicle on the account.

reauth_confirm.title: Teslemetry access token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Teslemetry no longer accepts the saved access token. Enter a new token for the same account.

abort.already_configured: This Teslemetry account is already configured.
abort.no_vehicles: There are no vehicles on this Teslemetry account.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different Teslemetry account.

get_alerts.name: Get alerts
get_alerts.description: Returns the alerts held for each vehicle, newest first, with full detail. Includes the history Teslemetry sends on connect, up to 100 alerts per vehicle.

device_id.name: Vehicles
device_id.description: Vehicles to return. Leave empty for all.

active_only.name: Active only
active_only.description: Only return alerts that have not ended.

audience.name: Audience
audience.description: Only return alerts for this audience.
